root_text: Beware of Misinformation!  Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is not a new deadly virus. It shares symptoms with COVID-19 but is less severe. Stay informed, practice good hygiene, and don’t panic. #HMPV #COVID19 #HMPVoutbreak
